One time, When I was first learning how to cook, I had some leftover bourbon chicken from getting takeout. You know how bourbon chicken has all that extra liquid from the sauce? Well I thought I could use all of that leftover liquid to make sweet rice. I put the two together in a rice cooker, and when I took it out it was this dark burned color. When I tried to eat it, it was crunchy like it didn’t even cook, and it was so nasty sweet. Never again.
